Simulated Drivers#

VirtualDMM

DMM simulated in-process: no transport, server, or hardware.

SimulatedDMM

Client for the in-process simulated DMM SCPI server.

Types & Configuration#

MeasurementFunction

DMM measurement function (mode).

RangeMode

DMM range mode published on range_mode.cmd.

DMMMeasurementConfig

DMM acquisition config.

DMMConfig

Validated config for constructing an InstroDMM from JSON.

MeasurementConfig

Initial measurement state, applied through the InstroDMM setters on open().

VisaDriverConfig

Driver config for a VISA-connected DMM.

resolve_dmm_from_config

Resolve a validated DMMConfig into the (name, driver, config_publishers, poll_interval) InstroDMM needs.

Shared configuration#

Class

Description

DeviceInfo

Device metadata.

TimingConfig

Timing configuration for instrument background polling.

NominalCorePublisherConfig

Publisher config for streaming to a Nominal Core dataset.

FilePublisherConfig

Publisher config for writing measurements to a local file.

Errors raised by these methods are documented in Exceptions.
